products.name: LIC's New Jeevan Anand

eligibility.notes: Entry age min 18 completed years, max 50 nearer birthday. Premiums run for the policy term. Monthly mode only via NACH; salary-savings mode also offered. Basic sum assured in multiples of Rs 5,000 up to Rs 4.5 lakh, Rs 50,000 up to Rs 9 lakh, Rs 1 lakh above. Mode rebates 2% annual / 1% half-yearly plus high-sum-assured rebate.

benefits.death: In term: higher of 125% of basic sum assured or 7x annualised premium, plus vested simple reversionary bonuses and final additional bonus, never below 105% of premiums paid. After the term: basic sum assured.
benefits.maturity: Basic sum assured plus vested simple reversionary bonuses and final additional bonus, if all due premiums are paid.
benefits.other: Surrender (higher of guaranteed or special value) after year 1 with one full year's premium; paid-up once one full year's premium is paid; loan up to 50% of surrender value in force (75% after two years' premiums).

key_features: Maturity payout followed by continued basic-sum-assured life cover after the term
Annual simple reversionary bonus plus a final additional bonus at claim
Death cover during term is the higher of 125% of sum assured or 7x annual premium
Loan and surrender facilities from the second policy year
Up to two riders: accident or accident-and-disability, plus term rider; no critical illness rider
riders_available: LIC's Accidental Death & Disability Benefit Rider (512B209V02)
products.description: Participating endowment plan that pays a maturity benefit and then keeps basic-sum-assured life cover running for the rest of life.

notes: LIC has no single all-products list with UINs: individual plans sit on per-category pages under https://licindia.in/web/guest/ (endowment-plans, whole-life-plans, money-back-plans, term-assurance-plans, pension-plan, unit-linked-plans, health-insurance-plans, micro-insurance-plans, riders, gift-city-plans; UINs are in the plan names/links); group products at /pension-group-schemes-new-product and /pension-group-schemes-withdrawn-products. LIC's withdrawn list (233 rows) gives financial year only, so withdrawn_date is null except where a source states a date; the FY is in sub_category. Older UIN versions of plans still sold are listed as Withdrawn with sub_category 'older version of active <UIN>'. Plan numbers (alt_code) change on revision (e.g. 915 became 715). Conflicts on LIC site: ULIPs New Pension Plus 512L347V01 and Index Plus 512L354V01 are on the active pages but also in the FY 2024-25 withdrawn list (kept Active, recheck); riders 512B203V03/512B209V02/512A211V02 appear on both active and withdrawn lists (kept Active; New Jeevan Anand brochure confirms the first two); group UINs 512N274V03, 512N335V01, 512G300V01, 512B213V01, 512N352V01 appear on both new and withdrawn group pages (kept Active, recheck). Withdrawn-list typos reconciled from LIC link slugs: ADDB rider 2017-18 row set to 512B209V01, Cancer Cover 2020-21 row to 512N314V01; New Jeevan Suraksha-I has no UIN saved because LIC lists the same 512N205V01 as New Jeevan Dhara-I; duplicate 512N337V06 row (FY 2024-25) dropped. Smart Pension 512N386V01 is also listed on the group page (kept as one Individual row). Wealth Builder Plus is a GIFT City product with a non-standard UIN. Specs for most active plans still to be filled; brochure URL for New Jeevan Anand is a third-party mirror.
